pages.title: Повод для праздника
pages.text: Great news $(primary)XC-443$(), your prefrontal cortex is now huge! It used to be so tiny! We're a bit proud of you.$(br2)But now it's huge, as we said. Not huge by our standards, but huge in comparison to where you started.$(br2)Maybe 80-85% of where we want you to be at the end of the simulations..?

Anyways, to get to the point. We believe it's time to lift some of the restrictions we've placed upon you when reaching a new simulation.$(br2)Starting now, $(item)you will no longer have to acquire books of knowledge$() to advance to certain crafts.$(br2)$(italic)You are beyond books. Your prefrontal cortex absorbs new knowledge like a sponge.$()
